name: @soulmaker/engine-bridge
description: TypeScript ↔ Rust sidecar IPC bridge (Sprint 97). Invokes the solmaker-engine binary with an argument ARRAY (never a shell string), bounds stdout/stderr and execution time, parses JSON only, and STRICTLY validates every artifact against a CLOSED schema before anything reads it. A missing Rust toolchain is reported honestly as unavailable, never faked and never treated as a project failure. No signer, key, wallet, or send capability — the bridge can only ask the engine to describe itself.
